Resolves #20633

Scene 2 of `WorkstationFiveBeatNL` pins the torn-out popup's whole `WorkstationBootstrap` with `toEqual`. #20623 added `shell` to that frozen object, so every engine-tier e2e run, `dev`'s included, failed at `:1843` with an extra `"shell": false`. The expected object now lists `shell: false`, which is what a browser-born popup reports, and the pin stays exact.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium e2e against the dev server, red on `dev`, green at head) → L3 required (the ticket's three ACs). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one line in a spec's expected object; no product code.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | The scene 2 bootstrap pin (the `toEqual` at `WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs:1843`, in "scene 2 — the tear-out: a real pointer drag births a vessel MID-GESTURE") lists `shell: false`. |
| AC-2 | On `dev` (`7214b9249e`), `-g "births a vessel MID-GESTURE"` ran 1 test, which failed with `+ "shell": false` at `:1843`. At `514ca9fbc9` the whole spec passes 11/11 (3 headed variants skipped, as in CI). |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `e2e-engine (3/14)` on this head. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. Intake: `Prescription checked: test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs — owns the concern`. `apps/workstation/index.html` writes `shell` as #20623 intends, and `VesselWorkspace` reads it, so the stale side is the spec. No other spec pins the object.

- **Red on `dev`:** the scene 2 tear-out test fails with the `"shell": false` diff, the same diff as `dev`'s own `e2e-engine (3/14)` (job 128897787827), #20630 and #20631.
- **Green at head:** `WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs` 11 passed, 3 skipped.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the commit hooks ran.
